scope: Native DD cross-plan comparison for case13 old f396 right30 25f versus new f845 left20 21f; executed finalists only, not a globally searched optimum or user-labeled best frame.
integrity: The cross-plan judge received strictly validated original native DD videos, source windows, Stage2 endpoints and DWPose motion evidence. Both are actual DD outputs.
visual_corrections: NEW845 source and generated are different camera views. Direct 2D left/right leg direction is not evidence of action error. After source DWPose joints are reprojected using actual DD depth/cameras, the final generated leg joints are about 10.6 px mean from projected source, while arm joints are about 56.9 px mean away at f20; arm error grows through late frames. Thus 5/5 exact pose/hands/arms claim is still unsupported, but leg continuation is substantially better than a direct cross-view screenshot suggests.

NEW845 preserves a visible person and coherent rooftop across all 21 Stage3 frames and shows a leg extension that broadly matches the reprojected target-view pose. Face and hands are soft; arm motion departs increasingly from projected source, especially late. The chosen 20-degree camera angle yields modest orbit.

OLD396 source lean/arm extension is reasonably echoed across the 25-frame generated sequence, but upper-left building grows black/floating artifacts later and lower body/feet press or cross frame edges. Thus old scene/action also cannot be declared passed.
Model text says OLD396 background only shifts slightly, underweighting conspicuous floating building artifacts; its severity language for pose melting is not a reliable objective measurement.
conclusion: NEW845 is preferred on person/rooftop continuity in this two-finalist set. Its leg motion is broadly supported by target-view geometry, but late arm pose and detail are not exact; model all-5 absolute score is unsupported. Neither full Stage3 quality nor global best is proven.
